post.description: Outgoing user-configured receiver contract, not a callable Oddswire API route. Verify HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + period + exact raw body using the base64url-decoded target secret and a 300-second timestamp tolerance; durably deduplicate verified body id before 2xx. At-least-once retries preserve body/event/delivery IDs with fresh timestamp/attempt. Six attempts maximum, earlier freshness/kickoff expiry, no redirects. Current access and alerts-purpose rights required; no external origin enabled by default.

200.description: Receiver durably deduplicated and accepted the event.

202.description: Receiver durably deduplicated and enqueued the event.

204.description: Receiver accepted an event, including an already processed duplicate.
